item.title: 2027 Planner Bundle: Habit Tracker
item.description: Start 2027 organised: plan your year, run your budget, keep the house under control and track every book you read, and build better habits all year. Five of our planners in one money-saving bundle.

item.title: 2027 Minimalist Planner
item.description: Start 2027 organised with a calm, minimalist printable planner. Fully dated for 2027, with Sunday-start and Monday-start versions in US Letter and A4.

item.title: Budget Planner Printable with Savings Challenges
item.description: Take control of your money with a simple, calm printable budget planner and six savings challenges. Amounts have no currency symbol, so it works in dollars, pounds, euros, rand or any currency.

item.title: Budget Planner Spreadsheet Google Sheets & Excel
item.description: Take control of your money with an easy budget spreadsheet that does the maths for you. Works in Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel (also Numbers and LibreOffice).

item.title: Meal Planner Printable with Grocery List
item.description: Plan your week, shop smarter and stop asking "what's for dinner?". A clean, simple printable meal planner that you can print again and again.

item.title: ADHD-Friendly Cleaning Checklists
item.description: A calmer, cleaner home, one small job at a time. Clear checklists, easy routines and bite-size task cards that make cleaning less overwhelming, especially if you have ADHD or a busy family life.
